static_code_reading.units: ppi_logistic_pointestimate signature and one-step search within this file
static_code_reading.finding: This function signature has no one_step argument; no package-wide absence assertion
With lam=None, pointestimate tunes with clip=True, then its one_step branch uses pooled information. With a fixed lam, it returns the optimizer result
_logistic_get_stats uses pooled label/auxiliary information when use_unlabeled=True
The CI one_step branch computes an unclipped weight and calls pointestimate with a fixed lam; the fixed-lam pointestimate path does not enter its Newton-update branch
Trace tuning uses labelled cross-covariance divided by n, pooled np.cov, and optional clipping to [0,1]

new_comparator_scope: A ridge-start implementation of the published scalar-weight and one-step formulas, with the original pilot held common; compare pooled/labelled information and clipped/unrestricted power. No upstream bug fix or new estimator claim
